summary: Frontend-only external preview verification completed. The OfficeFlow login page loads at the requested preview URL, renders the expected welcome/hero content and controls, accepts input, and remains usable on mobile. The preview still returns 404 for the public settings API, so dynamic branding cannot load.

integration_issues.issue: The browser requests https://officeflow-v3.preview.emergentagent.com/api/settings/public and receives HTTP 404 application/json (observed twice). The login page falls back to default OfficeFlow branding and emits console 404 errors.

action_items: Fix the external preview ingress/proxy so /api/settings/public reaches the backend instead of returning 404.
Retest dynamic public branding and login submission after API routing is corrected.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.js and App.js contain the expected route and stable data-testid hooks; the remaining failure is deployment/preview API routing rather than a missing frontend route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: External /login rendering, input typing, submit click, desktop layout, and mobile layout passed. Verify /api/settings/public routing first; no source files were changed.
rca of the issue: AppSettingsContext calls api.get('/settings/public'), which becomes /api/settings/public in the browser. The external preview host returns a JSON 404 for that path, so the request never reaches the backend and DEFAULTS remain active.
